basis: Scope map 3.3 Must explain; SEP-PKI-01 and 02.

slots.question: Which certificates do the hosts hold, and which CA issued each (enterprise IT CA, OT CA, self-signed, vendor)?
Which private root CAs do the hosts trust (enterprise, OT, product, TLS inspection)?
Which certificates expire within a three-month isolation, or have already expired, and how are they renewed (auto-enrolment from the IT CA)?
Does the application itself use certificates or TLS (web services, SQL encryption, radio management), and which certificates?
Where is revocation checked (CRL distribution points, OCSP), and are those reachable during isolation?
